title: Product Owner – Agile Delivery, Product Vision & Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management
description:
****Job Summary****
Synechron is seeking a Product Owner with
**7–12 years of experience**
to define and communicate product vision and strategy in alignment with business goals. The role is responsible for managing the product backlog, engaging stakeholders, guiding delivery teams, and using market and customer insights to support product decisions. The Product Owner will connect business needs with engineering, design, and data science capabilities to ensure that product features are clearly defined, prioritized, and delivered effectively. The role contributes to business objectives by improving product value, supporting customer-focused outcomes, and ensuring that product development remains aligned with market needs and organizational priorities.
  
  
****Required****
**Software Requirements**

* Proficiency with at least one product backlog and work-management tool, with practical experience managing epics, features, user stories, tasks, priorities, and workflows.
* Experience using tools that support sprint planning, burndown metrics, velocity tracking, release planning, and task definition.
* Experience with collaboration and documentation tools used for requirements management, stakeholder communication, decision tracking, and product documentation.
* Experience with digital tools for analyzing user feedback, market information, product performance, or customer insights.
* Working knowledge of software development lifecycle and agile delivery tools at a level appropriate for a Product Owner with 7–12 years of experience.
* Ability to learn and use the software tools adopted by Synechron or the assigned delivery team.

****Preferred****

* Experience with integrated agile planning, product road-mapping, reporting, and portfolio-management platforms.
* Experience using analytics, dashboarding, experimentation, or customer-feedback tools to support product decisions.
* Experience with prototyping, wireframing, or UX collaboration tools.
* Experience with tools that support requirements traceability, release governance, and product documentation.
* Experience with automation or artificial intelligence-enabled product-management tools, where relevant to the product area.

Equivalent tools and platforms may be considered where they demonstrate the same capabilities.
  
  
****Overall Responsibilities****

* Articulate and champion the product vision and strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives and measurable customer outcomes.
* Translate business goals, customer needs, market information, and stakeholder input into an actionable product roadmap.
* Effectively prioritize and maintain the product backlog, focusing on the delivery of the most valuable features and improvements.
* Define clear acceptance criteria and maintain sufficient detail for the development team to estimate, plan, build, test, and release product increments.
* Craft clear and detailed user stories that communicate business value, user needs, functional expectations, dependencies, and relevant constraints.
* Engage with stakeholders across the organization to gather requirements, clarify priorities, manage expectations, and ensure the product meets diverse needs.
* Lead the development team through each iteration by providing timely decisions, clarifying requirements, and ensuring that the product evolves coherently with the established vision.
* Collaborate with engineering, design, data science, quality assurance, and other cross-functional teams to launch and manage products.
* Conduct market research and monitor industry trends, customer expectations, and competitor activities to support product strategy.
* Analyze user feedback, product data, and delivery outcomes to identify opportunities for product improvement.
* Support sprint planning, reviews, demonstrations, retrospectives, release planning, and other agile activities as required.
* Maintain traceability between product objectives, backlog items, acceptance criteria, delivered outcomes, and customer value.
* Consider sustainable product and delivery practices, including efficient use of technology resources, responsible prioritization, accessibility, maintainability, and long-term product viability.
* Measure performance through relevant outcomes such as customer value, adoption, delivery predictability, product quality, stakeholder alignment, and progress against agreed objectives.
* Make prioritization and clarification decisions within the agreed product scope, escalating material risks, conflicts, dependencies, or changes in direction when appropriate.

****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****

* Ability to understand technical discussions, software requirements, system behavior, dependencies, and delivery constraints sufficiently to make informed product decisions.

****Preferred****

* Familiarity with programming concepts or exposure to commonly used languages relevant to the product domain.
* Ability to review basic technical documentation, application flows, or implementation considerations with engineering teams.

**Databases/Data Management**
****Essential****

* Understanding of how product data, customer feedback, business metrics, and operational information support product decisions.
* Ability to define data-related requirements and collaborate with data, engineering, or analytics teams.

****Preferred****

* Familiarity with relational or non-relational databases and data integration concepts.
* Experience using product analytics, reporting, dashboards, or data-quality information to evaluate outcomes.

**Cloud Technologies**
****Essential****

* Working understanding of how cloud-based software delivery may affect product requirements, scalability, availability, security, cost, and release planning.

****Preferred****

* Experience managing or contributing to products delivered through cloud platforms.
* Familiarity with cloud-related concepts such as environments, services, APIs, monitoring, resilience, and resource efficiency.

**Frameworks and Libraries**
****Essential****

* Ability to work with engineering teams to understand the impact of frameworks, libraries, integrations, and technical dependencies on product delivery.

****Preferred****

* Familiarity with frameworks, APIs, integration patterns, or front-end and back-end product components relevant to the assigned product area.

Development Tools and Methodologies
  
  
****Essential****

* Proficiency in agile methodologies and software development cycles.
* Practical experience with backlog management, sprint planning, prioritization, estimation, burndown metrics, velocity, task definition, reviews, and release planning.
* Experience defining user stories, acceptance criteria, product requirements, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience collaborating with engineering, design, data science, quality assurance, and other cross-functional teams.
* Understanding of customer-centric product development and UX design principles.

****Preferred****

* Experience with Scrum, Kanban, scaled agile practices, or hybrid delivery approaches.
* Experience with product discovery, experimentation, MVP definition, roadmap planning, service design, or outcome-based planning.
* Experience using delivery metrics to identify risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.

**Security Protocols**
****Essential****

* Awareness of security, privacy, compliance, accessibility, and data-protection considerations relevant to product requirements.
* Ability to involve appropriate technical and risk stakeholders when security or privacy requirements affect product scope or delivery.

****Preferred****

* Experience working with products subject to regulated data, identity and access management, secure development practices, audit requirements, or formal risk controls.
* Familiarity with defining security and privacy acceptance criteria.

****Experience Requirements****

* 7–12 years of experience in product management, product ownership, business analysis, technology delivery, or a similar role.
* Demonstrable experience managing product lifecycles in a fast-paced, agile environment.
* Proven experience defining product vision, maintaining and prioritizing backlogs, creating user stories, and establishing acceptance criteria.
* Experience working closely with engineering, design, data science, quality assurance, and other cross-functional teams to launch and manage products.
* Experience gathering requirements and feedback from stakeholders with diverse business or customer needs.
* Experience using market research, user feedback, product data, and industry trends to adjust product strategy.
* Preferred experience within a technology-focused organization or an environment involving digital products, software platforms, data products, or technology-enabled services.
* Candidates may also qualify through equivalent combinations of product ownership, product management, business analysis, delivery leadership, domain expertise, and demonstrated product outcomes, even where their career path does not follow a traditional product title progression.

**Day-to-Day Activities**

* Review and update the product backlog to reflect changing priorities, dependencies, user feedback, market information, and agreed business objectives.
* Conduct stakeholder meetings and discovery discussions to collect feedback, clarify requirements, refine product features, and communicate decisions.
* Collaborate with the development team during sprint planning, reviews, demonstrations, refinement sessions, releases, and issue resolution.
* Analyze user feedback, market data, delivery metrics, and product outcomes; make decisions within product scope and escalate material risks or priority conflicts.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.
* Master’s degree in a related discipline is preferred but not required.
* Certification in product management, product ownership, agile delivery, or a related discipline is preferred; relevant demonstrated experience may be accepted in place of certification.
* Completion of role-relevant training in agile methods, product discovery, UX, stakeholder management, data-informed decision-making, security, or accessibility is preferred.
* Commitment to continuous professional development through relevant training, industry learning, practical experience, and awareness of evolving product, technology, customer, and sustainability practices.

**Professional Competencies**

* Apply critical thinking and structured problem-solving to evaluate product options, manage ambiguity, identify dependencies, and make evidence-based decisions.
* Provide clear direction while working effectively with engineering, design, data science, and other cross-functional teams.
* Communicate product vision, priorities, requirements, trade-offs, risks, and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Adapt product plans based on customer feedback, market dynamics, delivery information, emerging technology, and changing business priorities.
* Identify opportunities for innovation and improvement while maintaining focus on customer value, usability, accessibility, security, maintainability, and sustainable outcomes.
* Manage time, priorities, dependencies, and competing stakeholder needs while maintaining attention to detail and delivery commitments.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Type**
Full-time
  
  
**Description**
**About CloudBees**
CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.
  
  
Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.
  
  
CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.
  
  
Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
  
  
Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.
  
  
**About The Team**
CloudBees builds CloudBees Unify, a governed software delivery platform spanning CI/CD, release orchestration, and feature management. Feature Management is the capability that lets teams ship code with a feature turned off, roll it out gradually, and kill it instantly if something breaks, no redeploy needed.
  
  
This team is moving into a new org, and that's where you come in.
  
  
You'd inherit a team spread across three continents and about ten time zones, and likely pick up one or two additional small teams alongside it. The team includes engineers who do not need you to tell them how to write code. What they need is someone who clears the path between them and shipping and treats "I don't know, let me find out" as a perfectly good answer in a 1:1.
  
  
This is the role today. If you do it well, there's room to take on more.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own delivery and team health for Feature Management
* Steer decisions with questions, then let your engineers own the architecture. If you're the one drawing the boxes, something's gone wrong
* Give feedback in the moment, not in a surprise essay once a year
* Hire, grow, and have the hard conversations when someone isn't where they need to be
* Cut process that exists because someone was once scared
* Use AI agents to run your own job faster: pull together who's on PTO next week, the lead time of your team's PRs, what ticket needs attention, what shipped and what it broke, instead of digging through five tools by hand

Not write code. Not approve every PR. Not sit in on every incident call because you don't trust the on-call rotation.
  
  
**Requirements**
**What we're looking for**
**Must have**

* A track record of improving automation and developer tooling, not just using what's handed to you
* At least 5 years as a software developer before moving into management, so the technical instincts below are earned, not borrowed (ideally, you have developed in Go)
* 5+ years as an actual engineering manager, with 5 or more direct reports at once. Not a tech lead with 3 reports and half a week of coding
* Genuinely technical: enough hands-on background in CI/CD, feature flagging, or platform engineering to ask a sharp question in a design review, plus real experience managing engineers who are better coders than you, and you're comfortable with that
* A track record of running distributed, multi-timezone teams: clear owners, clear deadlines, decisions that don't wait on a meeting that nine time zones won't allow
* You take the heat for your team and hand them the credit
* The instinct to measure what shipped and what it did for customers, not green dots in Slack. You know deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and time to restore, and you use them to start conversations, not to rank people
* A real appetite for AI: recent, hands-on use of at least one coding agent (Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor, Kiro, or similar) to run your own work, not necessarily to ship product code. You push your team to try these tools too, and have opinions about where they help and where they don't, not secondhand takes from a keynote you watched once
* Experience taking over a team mid-transition

**Nice to have**

* A sense of humor. You'll need one some days, and it'll help on the good ones too
* Prior exposure to release orchestration
* Java development experience

**Who This Is For**
You'd rather ask what's actually blocking someone than "why isn't this done yet." And when the unpopular call is needed, you make it, even when the timing is inconvenient.
  
  
You're fine with ambiguity that has a shape, not ambiguity that's just chaos with a Jira board. Sharp and a little irreverent beats technically flawless but rigid, as long as you still ship.

title: Engineering Lead
description:
**Engineering Lead**

**Company:**
Stoopa.AI

**Employment type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
Typically 8+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including technical leadership and delivery ownership

About Stoopa.AI

Stoopa.AI builds TURI, a software platform for ports, terminals, and container logistics operations. TURI connects operational data, real-time visibility, configurable workflows, and decision intelligence to help customers coordinate operations and make better decisions.

We are looking for a hands-on engineering leader who can guide engineers, make sound architectural decisions, establish practical engineering standards, and take accountability for delivery and customer outcomes.

About the role

As Engineering Lead, you will own technical direction and engineering delivery for your team. You will turn product priorities and customer requirements into clear designs, executable plans, and dependable releases.

You will remain actively involved in design, code reviews, implementation, and production troubleshooting while helping engineers deliver effectively. You will also serve as a primary technical contact for customers across the world, leading technical discussions, managing expectations, and ensuring that commitments are understood and followed through.

Our technology includes Java, Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, Python, SQL databases, and Redis, deployed in cloud environments. Machine learning and agentic AI experience are significant advantages.

What you will do

·        Lead architecture and technical design across frontend applications, backend services, databases, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.

·        Translate business goals and customer requirements into technical plans, milestones, estimates, and clear ownership.

·        Take accountability for end-to-end delivery, from discovery and design through development, testing, deployment, customer acceptance, and production support.

·        Coordinate engineering work, manage dependencies, remove blockers, and address delivery risks early.

·        Work with product leadership and customers to agree priorities, clarify scope, and communicate trade-offs when requirements or timelines change.

·        Establish and improve practical standards for architecture, coding, reviews, testing, security, documentation, CI/CD, and production monitoring.

·        Guide and mentor engineers, delegate effectively, provide constructive feedback, and hold the team accountable for quality and commitments.

·        Contribute code to critical or complex areas and help resolve difficult technical and production issues.

·        Lead customer requirements workshops, technical demonstrations, integration discussions, and rollout planning across countries and time zones.

·        Communicate progress, decisions, risks, and recovery plans clearly to customers and company leadership.

·        Drive incident resolution and follow-up improvements that strengthen reliability and prevent recurring issues.

·        Evaluate technologies thoughtfully, including ML and agentic AI approaches, and guide their use where they solve a clear product or customer need.

What you bring

·        Typically 8+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated experience leading engineers and delivering production software.

·        Strong hands-on Java and Spring Boot expertise, with the ability to guide full stack development using React and TypeScript.

·        Practical Python development experience.

·        Strong SQL, relational database design, query optimization, and Redis caching experience.

·        Experience designing maintainable systems, APIs, and integrations, with attention to security, reliability, and performance.

·        Practical cloud architecture and deployment experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.

·        Experience with Docker, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and production operations.

·        A track record of owning delivery, managing scope and dependencies, and responding constructively when plans change.

·        Excellent written and oral communication skills, including clear technical proposals, delivery updates, and customer-facing discussions.

·        Experience managing direct technical relationships with customers, resolving ambiguity, and setting realistic expectations.

·        Strong ownership and accountability, including the willingness to make decisions, escalate risks, and follow through on outcomes.

·        Ability to lead through clear direction, technical credibility, coaching, and collaboration.

·        Ability to coordinate with international customers and distributed teams across time zones.

Experience that is a significant plus

·        Designing, deploying, or operating machine learning capabilities in production.

·        Building agentic AI applications using LangGraph, LangChain, or similar frameworks.

·        Microsoft Azure architecture and operations experience.

·        Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architecture, event-driven systems, or Kubernetes.

·        Familiarity with logistics, ports, terminals, or enterprise operational systems.

Why join us

You will have meaningful influence over the architecture, engineering practices, and delivery of a product serving international customers. You will work closely with company leadership, guide a hands-on engineering team, and help turn complex operational requirements into reliable software

title: Test Engineering  Senior Associate
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
  
  
Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
  
  
The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
  
  
**Pay And Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
The Test Engineering role is responsible for ensuring that all applications, system products, projects, and solutions meet defined enterprise quality standards. Provide centralized, independent quality assurance services across the firm, including functional and non-functional testing for all products, services, and applications across businesses. Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions, providing testing expertise, oversight, and direction to ensure the functionality of solutions and that design specifications are met.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Safeguard a global post-trade platform — Your test automation will directly protect the reliability of a system used daily by investment managers, broker/dealers, and custodian banks worldwide, where a single defect can carry real financial and regulatory consequences.
* Raise the quality bar across the SDLC — You will embed quality earlier and deeper into delivery, shifting testing left and enabling faster, more confident releases without compromising stability.
* Accelerate delivery through AI-augmented testing — By leveraging AI for test generation, self-healing UI locators, and reusable automation assets, you'll reduce manual test effort, shorten regression cycles, and free the team to focus on higher-value work.
* De-risk a major platform modernization — Your validation of Oracle-to-PostgreSQL database migrations will ensure data integrity and functional parity as the platform modernizes, protecting the business from migration-related regressions.
* Elevate the engineering team — Through technical leadership and mentorship, you'll uplift the QA engineering team's skills, establish automation best practices, and create a durable culture of quality ownership.
* Enable full-stack confidence — By driving coverage across UI, API, database, and integration layers of a multi-service containerized architecture, you'll give stakeholders end-to-end assurance that the platform behaves correctly at every tier.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 7+ years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

**Talents Needed For Success**

* 7+ years of hands-on test automation engineering, ideally within complex, large-scale enterprise or financial platforms.
* Deep expertise in keyword-driven / data-driven automation frameworks, including designing, extending, and maintaining reusable framework components.
* Strong programming skills in a language such as Python, Java, or C# for building robust, maintainable automation.
* Proven experience automating across multiple layers — UI, REST/SOAP API, database, and end-to-end integration testing.
* Solid database and SQL proficiency, with practical experience validating data across relational systems (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and testing data migrations.
* Working knowledge of containerized, microservices architectures (e.g., Docker/Kubernetes) and testing in distributed, multi-service environments.
* Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab) for continuous testing.
* Exposure to AI-assisted testing tools for test generation, self-healing locators, or intelligent test maintenance is a strong plus.
* Prior experience leading or mentoring QA engineers and setting technical direction for a testing practice.
* Capital markets, post-trade, or broader financial services domain experience is highly desirable.

Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Join athenahealth as a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a newly formed engineering team advancing our Integration Platform. You will build and develop the team, guide technical direction, and own the delivery of scalable, reliable integration solutions.
  
  
Working closely with engineering, product, architecture, and operational stakeholders, you will help simplify healthcare data exchange and improve the experience of developers, customers, and integration partners. A key focus will be advancing automation, self-service capabilities, and AI-powered tooling to reduce integration turnaround time and improve engineering productivity.
  
  
**Team Summary**
The Integration Platform is part of the athenahealth Data and Ecosystem Platform subdivision. It supports internal data exchanges and connections between athenahealth and laboratories, imaging providers, registries, health information exchanges (HIEs), payers, other electronic health record (EHR) systems, faxing services, and third-party vendors serving healthcare practices.
  
  
A core component is our proprietary HL7 engine, which supports more than 15,000 contexts, approximately 20,000 connections, and millions of subscriptions. These connections use protocols and connectivity methods such as SFTP, HTTPS, APIs, and VPN sockets, making scalability, performance, and reliability central to the team’s work.
  
  
The platform supports inbound and outbound HL7 connections, alongside custom integrations for specific customer needs. Self-service tools and a dedicated advisory team support the onboarding, development, and validation of new integrations.
  
  
The Chennai team will expand these capabilities through platform improvements, process automation, and AI-powered tools that simplify integration development, testing, and onboarding.
  
  
**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* Drive the adoption of AI-assisted development lifecycle (AIDLC) practices across planning, design, implementation, testing, and maintenance, with appropriate engineering review and quality controls.
* Identify and deliver opportunities for automation, self-service, and AI-powered tooling to reduce integration turnaround time and improve developer and customer experiences.
* Establish and track meaningful measures of delivery predictability, software quality, platform reliability, engineering productivity, and integration turnaround time.
* Lead the evolution of existing systems while supporting new functionality and maintaining operational continuity.
* Foster agile / AIDLC development practices and use delivery outcomes and team feedback to improve how the team works.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing engineering team, establishing clear goals, accountability, and a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Coach and mentor engineers through regular feedback, career development, and opportunities to strengthen technical and leadership skills.
* Own engineering planning and delivery for integration and faxing solutions, managing priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
* Partner with product, architecture, and engineering leaders to translate business objectives into a technical roadmap and achievable delivery plans.
* Guide architectural decisions and engineering practices that improve platform scalability, performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.

**Additional Job Responsibilities**

* Contribute to the long-term architecture and modernization strategy for the Integration Platform.
* Lead recruiting, onboarding, and talent development to build the capabilities needed for the team’s roadmap.
* Partner with operational and advisory teams to identify recurring integration challenges and translate them into reusable platform capabilities.
* Maintain productive relationships with internal stakeholders, external partners, and vendors.
* Support production readiness, incident resolution, and follow-up improvements that strengthen platform reliability.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and AI development tools through focused experiments with measurable outcomes.
* Share technical knowledge and effective engineering practices across teams.

**Expected Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.
* At least 12 years of experience across software development and engineering leadership, including experience managing engineering teams.
* Demonstrated ability to build and develop teams, manage performance, and deliver complex software initiatives.
* Strong technical background in Java and experience designing, developing, or operating scalable enterprise software.
* Experience guiding architectural decisions, managing technical trade-offs, and improving software quality and operational reliability.
* Experience with agile development methodologies and continuous improvement practices.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted software development and opportunities to apply AI and automation to engineering workflows.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and trade-offs to non-technical audiences

**About Athenahealth**
***Our vision:***
*In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.*
***Our company culture:***
*Our talented*
*employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.*

*workspaces*
—

title: Tech Team Lead
description:
**Tech Team Lead**

**Founding Engineering Hire • Build from the Ground Up**

**Company:**
Allsec AI

**Location:**
Chennai (Hybrid)

**Website:**
www.allsec.ai

**Engagement Type:**
Full-Time | Early-Stage Start-up

**About Allsec AI**

Allsec AI is an AI-native, digital-first, omni-channel CX managed services company. We help enterprises unlock scalable, efficient, and real-time customer experience operations through agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and automation. We are redefining outsourcing by delivering packaged, outcome-led services that eliminate traditional contact Centre inefficiencies.

**About This Role**

This is a founding engineering hire. You will be joining a pre-revenue, product-stage company with no existing engineering team in place,
*which means you will be responsible for taking our base demo product and building it into a production-grade platform.*

You will work in close collaboration with a US-based Technical Consultant who will provide architectural direction and high-level technical guidance. For day-to-day operations, delivery execution, and team coordination, you will report to the India Operational Head.

As the company scales, you will build and lead a cross-functional team of engineers and own the India engineering operations end to end. If you are looking for a role where every decision you make has direct, visible impact.

**Reporting Structure**

* **Technical guidance, architecture direction, and product vision:**
  US-based Technical Consultant
* **Operational reporting, delivery accountability, and day-to-day coordination:**
  India Operational Head

**Key Responsibilities**

***Foundation & Architecture***

* Inherit, extend, and scale the existing technology stack (backend, frontend, DevOps, data pipelines, and ML/AI systems) building on a working demo product toward a production-ready platform.
* Establish production-grade engineering standards, tooling, and development processes, taking the codebase from demo quality to enterprise-ready.
* Define and own a scalable architecture for real-time, high-volume CX operations.

***Product & Infrastructure***

* Own and evolve the existing multi-cloud infrastructure (Digital Ocean, Azure, GCP) improving reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Extend and optimise existing integrations across multiple LLM providers, STT/TTS systems, AI agents, NLP pipelines, and vector databases.
* Ensure system observability, security, redundancy, and performance from day one.

***Team Building***

* As the first engineering hire, identify and help recruit subsequent technical team members.
* Mentor and develop engineers as the team scales; enforce best practices and foster technical excellence.
* Contribute actively to hiring decisions and help shape the engineering culture of the organisation.

***Collaboration & Stakeholder Management***

* Translate technical direction from the US-based Technical Consultant into executable roadmaps.
* Collaborate with CX implementation and QA functions to align technology with delivery operations.
* Actively participate in architectural decisions and long-term technical planning.

**Requirements**

* 6–10 years of total experience, with at least 1 year in a tech or team lead capacity.
* Deep experience with one or more full-stack frameworks (e.g., Node.js + React, Django + Vue, or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of AI/ML model development and deployment – LLMs, transformers, RAG pipelines.
* Proven experience with cloud platforms (Digital Ocean, Azure, and/or GCP) and infrastructure as code (Terraform/CDK).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, LangChain, vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS), and LLM APIs.
* Hands-on experience integrating and managing multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) alongside STT and TTS systems in production or near-production environments.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes), and scalable microservices.
* Demonstrated ability to operate with autonomy and build things without an established team or process around you.
* Good communication skills — you will primarily interface with a global stakeholder in the US and an operations-focused leader in India.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with contact centre platforms, chatbots, or voice AI systems.
* Exposure to MLOps, streaming data platforms, and real-time analytics dashboards.
* Prior start-up or early-stage product experience — particularly experience being the first or only engineer.
* Comfort working across time zones and with distributed teams.

**Why Join Allsec AI**

* You will be the architect of the technology foundation, i.e., you will take a working demo and turn it into the infrastructure that powers enterprise CX at scale; every architectural decision from here is yours.
* Work on cutting-edge AI/CX technology with global exposure and direct collaboration with the US technical leadership.
* Clear path to leading the India engineering organisation as the company scales.
* Competitive compensation and equity options available for the right candidate.

**Contact**

If you think this role excites you, please send your resumes to
**careers@allsec.ai**
&
**hr@allsec.ai**

CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.

Direct Responsibilities

* Work closely with the PO, sponsors to deliver the project deliverables, prioritization, estimations and planning

* 10+ years experience in working with large distributed IT teams practicing agile principles

* Certified scrum master
* Self starter with strong critical thinker with problem solving aptitude.
* Great listener and empathetic
* Good personality with a ‘can do' attitude and interpersonal skills
* Excellent written and oral communication skills

Advantages:

NA

* Ability to manage a project

* Analytical Ability

* Ability to develop and leverage networks

Behavioral Skills:
  
  

* Personal Impact / Ability to influence
* Ability to collaborate / Teamwork
* Active listening
* Communication skills oral & written
* Attention to detail / rigor
* Resilience

title: Senior Engineer I - QA
description:
**What is Contentstack?**
Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.
  
  
While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.
  
  
Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.
  
  
Learn more at www.contentstack.com.
  
  
**Who Are We?**
At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let's go!
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Own the test strategy for Platform (Web and API): decide what runs on every PR, nightly and at release
* Perform frontend and backend testing (Platform - Web, REST APIs, analytics and data pipelines)
* Perform regression and sanity testing across environments and cloud regions (AWS, GCP, Azure) and give a clear go/no-go for releases
* Design, build and maintain the UI and API automation frameworks (Playwright/Selenium), including shared page objects, fixtures, test data and stable selectors
* Add automated quality gates to CI/CD pipelines, and track and fix flaky tests
* Plan and run performance and load tests for APIs and data pipelines
* Validate data correctness for analytics and metering pipelines (completeness, duplicates, reconciliation)
* Build internal scripts and tools to automate QA processes and test data creation Generate testing reports, status reports and QA metrics (pass rate, defect escape rate) Create and maintain the test case repository
* Provide feedback to the developers, review test code and pull requests
* Mentor junior QA engineers and help developers write better tests
* Complete tasks in a timely manner
* Update internal product documentation

**Mandatory Skills**

* 3 to 5 years of QA experience, with at least 2 years in test automation
* Strong experience with JavaScript/TypeScript based E2E frameworks like Playwright or Cypress.io Experience designing an automation framework from scratch (page objects, fixtures, reporting)
* Strong knowledge of JSON and REST, and API test automation (Postman/Newman, REST Assured, Playwright API or similar)
* Experience in Load Testing with tools like JMeter, k6 or Locust
* Knowledge of Continuous Integration and hands-on experience with Jenkins, GoCD or GitHub Actions
* Experience in using Github and Git, including code reviews
* Experience in any bug reporting and test management tool such as JIRA
* Strong knowledge of the system development life cycle and the testing life cycle
* Experience in Agile/Scrum
* Good SQL and data validation skills; experience testing data or analytics pipelines is preferred
* Experience with logs and monitoring tools (Observe, Datadog or similar) for root cause analysis is preferred
* Basic knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes and cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure) is preferred Self-Directed - Ability to detect and solve problems

**What Do We Offer?**
**Interesting Work |**
We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the "challenge yourself" role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you're doing it.
  
  
**Tribe Vibe**
| We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict "no a\*\*hole policy" and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.
  
  
**Bragging Rights**
| We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!
  
  
**One Team One Dream**
| This is one of our values, and it shows. We don't believe in artificial hierarchies. If you're part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it's a great time to be joining…

Deep expertise in architecture and design patterns, cloud-native microservices, and building resilient, reliable, high-quality software.
  
  
Strong technical mindset with hands-on product development experience, the ability to deep-dive into complex technical issues, and staying current with the latest industry trends and technologies.
  
  
Strong leadership and team management skills, including matrix management, with the ability to mentor and motivate a high-performing team.

description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a hands-on Test Automation Architect with strong expertise in Tricentis Tosca, Java, Selenium WebDriver, and Cucumber/BDD frameworks. The candidate will be responsible for designing and scaling automation frameworks, integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, and leading a team of automation engineers to improve test coverage, quality, and execution efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Test Automation Framework Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks using Tricentis Tosca, Java, Selenium WebDriver, and Cucumber/BDD.
* Develop reusable, maintainable, and modular test cases and automation components.
* Establish coding standards, review automation scripts, and promote automation best practices.
* Implement Tosca-based automation solutions for enterprise applications.

**2. Test Automation & Functional Validation**

* Translate business requirements into executable test scenarios and test cases.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* Validate application workflows, integrations, reports, and user roles.
* Support release validation, patch testing, and regression cycles.

* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions.
* Configure parallel execution, scheduled runs, and headless testing where applicable.
* Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot failures, and implement quality gates and test reporting dashboards.

**4. Quality Engineering**

* Apply BDD/TDD, risk-based testing, test data management, and end-to-end traceability.
* Perform API testing using Postman, REST Assured, or SoapUI.
* Support cross-browser testing, data validation, accessibility testing, and basic performance testing.
* Analyze test failures, perform root cause analysis, and continuously improve automation stability.

**5. Team Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of 4–6 automation engineers.
* Plan sprints, allocate tasks, and track delivery in Agile Scrum/Kanban environments.
* Collaborate with developers, architects, product owners, and business stakeholders.
* Communicate automation progress, quality metrics, risks, and status updates to leadership.

**Mandatory Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong hands-on experience with Tricentis Tosca.
* Tricentis Tosca certification (AS1/AS2 or higher).
* Proficiency in Java, Selenium WebDriver, and Cucumber/BDD.
* Experience designing and maintaining scalable test automation frameworks.
* Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions.
* Knowledge of Tosca TestCase Design (TCD) and Test Data Service (TDS).
* Experience with JIRA and/or Azure DevOps for defect tracking and requirements traceability.
* Strong understanding of functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing.
* Experience in team leadership, mentoring, and Agile delivery.

Good-to-Have Skills

* API test automation using Postman, REST Assured, or SoapUI.
* Exposure to service virtualization and data modeling.
* Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals.
* Knowledge of accessibility and security testing.
* Understanding of performance testing fundamentals and test execution optimization.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Proven ability to improve automation coverage, framework reusability, and test execution efficiency.

title: Technical Anchor, Software Engineering
description:
As a Technical Anchor, you will oversee the technical design, development, and delivery of business-critical applications and high-throughput data platforms. You will establish engineering excellence across full-stack systems, architect resilient Java-based microservices, deliver responsive front-end data exploration interfaces using React or Angular, and design enterprise-grade cloud data streaming and analytical pipelines on GCP. You will lead distributed engineering squads across local and global locations, driving cloud modernization, data governance, and operational reliability to fuel Ford’s digital transformation.
  
  

* Technical Leadership, Architecture & Modernization
* Anchor Technical Delivery: Act as the primary technical anchor, translating complex business requirements from legacy applications in GDIA into scalable, fault-tolerant system designs, architectural blueprints, and execution roadmaps.
* Architecture Standards: Drive the evolution of Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA), cloud-native microservices, and event-driven patterns. Establish coding standards, API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger), and architectural governance across squads.
* Legacy System Modernization: Lead legacy modernization initiatives by re-architecting monolithic services into modular, containerized workloads on GCP, engineering continuous ingestion flows from heterogeneous enterprise platforms.
* Engineering Mentorship & SDLC Excellence: Champion agile engineering best practices, enforce test-driven development (TDD), lead comprehensive code reviews, and mentor engineers across full-stack, data engineering, and cloud domains.
* Full-Stack & Microservices Engineering
* Backend Services: Architect and develop robust, high-performance microservices and RESTful APIs using Java 17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and supporting synchronous transactions and asynchronous event-driven flows.
* Frontend & Data Visualization: Build responsive, user-centric interfaces using Angular, React, and Node.js that integrate seamlessly with backend APIs to deliver intuitive self-service data access, reporting, and interactive data visualization.
* API Gateway & Service Mesh: Design and standardize API gateway topologies using Apigee; enforce service discovery, circuit breakers, rate limiting, and resilient inter-service communication.
* Performance Engineering & Optimization: Profile and optimize distributed systems end-to-end, including JVM tuning, connection pooling, caching strategies, and database query tuning across relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL datastores.
* Cloud Data Engineering & Analytics
* Scalable Data Pipelines: Architect, build, and maintain real-time streaming and high-volume batch data pipelines leveraging GCP Dataflow (Apache Beam), Dataproc (Spark/Hadoop), and Cloud Pub/Sub.
* Modern Data Warehousing: Standardize, model, partition, and optimize enterprise datasets within Google BigQuery to ensure exceptional SQL query performance, cost efficiency, and real-time analytical capabilities.
* Security, Governance & Compliance
* Zero Trust Security: Enforce least-privileged access control across applications, integrating Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), ADFS, OAuth2/OIDC, and method-level access authorization.
* Cloud & Data Governance: Implement robust cloud security frameworks, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), data encryption (in transit and at rest), data masking, and GCP-native row-level and column-level security.
* Regulatory Compliance: Partner with cybersecurity, compliance, and governance teams to maintain adherence to enterprise data privacy mandates and corporate security standards.
* DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Observability
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Automate and manage repeatable cloud infrastructure and platform provisioning using Terraform.
* CI/CD Automation: Design and optimize enterprise CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Tekton, and build automation tools (Maven, Gradle) for automated testing, static code analysis, and zero-downtime deployments.
* Operational Reliability & Telemetry: Establish proactive monitoring, tracing, and alerting frameworks across Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Run, and Cloud Functions to diagnose distributed system bottlenecks and ensure platform health.
* AI/ML Innovation: Apply foundational AI and Machine Learning (ML) concepts, including Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), to accelerate engineering workflows and enhance software capabilities.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* Professional Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions across full-stack development, distributed computing, and data platforms. Core Technical Competencies:
* Backend Engineering: Deep expertise in Java (Java 17+), Spring Ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Data, Spring Security), and scripting proficiency.
* Frontend Engineering: Hands-on experience developing data visualization and exploration interfaces using React, Angular, or Node.js.
* GCP Cloud Platforms: Proven track record architecting and deploying systems on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), specifically BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE and Cloud Pub/Sub.
* Database Systems: Strong practical expertise with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL datastores, and columnar analytical warehouses.
* DevOps & IaC: Hands-on mastery of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and automated CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Tekton, Maven/Gradle).
* API & Testing Standards: Deep knowledge of RESTful API design (OpenAPI/Swagger) paired with a test-driven mindset using JUnit and Mockito

title: Senior Automation QA (JavaScript) Engineer
description: Job DescriptionCiklum is looking for a Senior Automation QA (JavaScript) Engineer to join our team full-time in India.We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.About The RoleAs a Senior Automation QA (JavaScript) Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Ciklum is seeking a Senior AI Automation QA Engineer to join the client project, an ambitious initiative to build an enterprise-grade Agent Development Platform (ADP) that our client will commercialize to their own customers. This is quality engineering for a system that is non-deterministic by nature, where "expected output" is a statistical claim rather than a string match, and where the platform's reliability guarantees no lost workflow runs, strict tenant isolation, graceful degradation under provider outages are contractual commitments, not aspirations. You will build the automation that proves those guarantees hold, release after release.You will own the test automation that spans the whole platform: the Frontend and Backend that agent developers depend on, the long-running Temporal workflows that must survive worker crashes and provider failures, the multi-tenant isolation boundaries that protect one customer's data from another, and the performance and concurrency targets defined in the platform's NFRs. Much of your craft is adversarial and failure-first injecting worker kills, retry storms, and malformed documents to verify the system recovers exactly as specified, and negative-testing disallowed tool calls and egress paths to confirm the sandbox holds. Where agent behavior must be judged rather than asserted, you will partner closely with the evaluation function, contributing the test infrastructure, synthetic-data pipelines, and CI integration that make quality measurable and repeatable.This is a high-visibility role where we establish the production-ready foundation the rest of the program is built on. Your automated suites become release gates, and the evidence they produce feeds directly into client milestone sign-offs so your work must be reproducible, trustworthy, and defensible to a sophisticated client. As the platform scales toward an "agent-a-month" delivery cadence, you will build the reusable test scaffolds and harnesses that let quality keep pace with delivery, ensuring that month twelve ships as safely as month one. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with AI engineers, platform engineers, and the evaluation team, embedding quality from the design stage rather than inspecting for it at the end.Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for the platform, Frontend and Backend, including contract tests that protect the agent-developer experience as the SDK evolves Build automated tests for long-running Temporal workflows including failure injection (worker kill, provider outage, retry storms) to verify durable-execution guarantees such as zero lost runs and correct compensation/saga behavior Automate multi-tenant isolation verification cross-tenant data access, configuration bleed, and cost-attribution correctness executed per release as a platform acceptance criterion Verify agent execution sandboxing and egress controls through negative testing of disallowed tool calls and network destinations AI-Specific & Non-Deterministic Testing Design test strategies for LLM-driven behavior: statistical assertions over repeated runs (pass^k consistency), semantic-similarity scoring, confidence-threshold validation, and flakiness quarantine that distinguishes model variance from genuine regression Build and continuously extend adversarial test corpora document-borne prompt injection in lease PDFs, tool-call hijack, and data-exfiltration probes aligned to OWASP LLM Top 10 and recognized red-team taxonomies Verify Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) escalation behavior confidence thresholds fire correctly and no gated/irreversible action completes without authorization Partner with the evaluation function on golden-dataset-driven checks, contributing test infrastructure, synthetic-data (synthetic lease) pipelines, and CI integration that make agent quality measurable and repeatable Performance, Reliability & NFR Verification Automate verification of platform NFRs invocation overhead (p95), concurrency targets, queue backpressure behavior, and LLM provider failover time and surface trends per release Use tracing data (Langfuse / OpenTelemetry spans) as a first-class test asset: assert on trace completeness, token/cost-accounting accuracy, and alerting behavior for anomalous runs Process, Evidence & Collaboration Wire test suites into CI/CD as hard release gates with automated, per-metric regression flagging on pull requests Produce auditable, reproducible test-evidence packs that feed directly into client milestone sign-off Embed with AI and platform engineers from the design stage making acceptance criteria, testability, and observability inputs to architecture, not afterthoughts Maintain test environments, mocked LLM/provider layers, and synthetic data generators that keep test runs fast, deterministic where possible, and affordable Mentor mid-level QA engineers, codify AI testing patterns into reusable internal frameworks, and contribute to Ciklum's quality engineering practice and AI Academy Requirements 8+ years of test automation with API testing, and building test frameworks other engineers adopt, not just test cases Hands-on experience testing LLM-powered or other non-deterministic systems statistical assertions, semantic scoring, and managing model variance (this is the differentiator; cite real examples) Experience testing asynchronous, event-driven systems failure injection, idempotency verification, eventual-consistency assertions; Temporal or a similar workflow engine a strong plus Strong CI/CD integration skills (GitHub Actions or equivalent) and the discipline to design release gates Solid SQL and data-validation skills; comfort building synthetic test-data pipelines and measuring dataset quality A security-testing and adversarial mindset; familiarity with prompt-injection techniques or a strong AppSec testing background with willingness to specialize fast Demonstrated judgment on what "tested enough" means under milestone pressure, and the ability to defend quality evidence to non-engineering stakeholders Strong proficiency in Playwright and TypeScript is mandatory for building automated test suites QA Automation Core: Extensive experience in building automated test frameworks (Playwright/Typescript-based) and integrating them into high-security CI/CD pipelines AI/LLM Literacy: Deep understanding of Large Language Model behaviors, prompt sensitivity, and the common failure modes of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems Analytical Mindset: Strong capability in statistical analysis to interpret evaluation scores and provide actionable feedback to AI Engineers for prompt tuning Desirable Performance/load tooling (k6, Locust) for concurrency and latency NFR verification Prior testing of multi-tenant SaaS isolation Exposure to eval/observability stacks (Langfuse, LangSmith, Promptfoo, DeepEval, Arize Phoenix) Compliance evidence experience (SOC 2, GDPR) or accessibility testing (Section 508 / WCAG) Familiarity with Commercial Real Estate workflows (lease accounting, CAM reconciliation) or document-extraction systems (OCR, layout parsing) Experience using LLMs to generate test cases, adversarial payloads, or synthetic documents Performance Testing: Experience testing high-concurrency background processing within agentic systems Experience with qTest for test management What’s in it for you?Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environmentGrowth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertiseTailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certificationsEndless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologiesCare: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultationsAbout UsAt Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!Interested already? We would love to get to know you! The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, strategists, designers, solution architects, other product owners, and developers with an emphasis on strengthening the client centric service delivery for the related business areas, within the context of best practices in enterprise architecture, modern sourcing techniques, modular design of solutions, and appropriate integration of IT services and platforms.

* Actively monitor client needs, industry trends, Bank priorities, KPIs, and user feedback.

* Strong understanding of business goals and the ability to translate them into product requirements.
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in developing and operationalizing product strategies and managing the full product lifecycle.
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and strong understanding of Agile planning tracking tools such as Azure DevOps.
* Proven track record of successfully developing and launching technology products in large-scale environments.
* Solid understanding of IT development lifecycles and methodologies.
* Proven ability to collaborate with other team members across boundaries and contribute productively to the team's work and output, demonstrating respect for different points of view.

title: Senior Java Lead Engineer
description:
Business / Organization Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and visionary
**Java Technical Lead (C12)**
to join our Enterprise Engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the design, implementation, and architectural evolution of high-throughput, mission-critical enterprise systems. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional architecture, product, and infrastructure teams to build scalable, resilient, and secure microservices and distributed event-driven platforms.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
As a C12 Technical Lead, you will combine hands-on technical execution with engineering leadership. You will drive architectural decisions, govern development standards, mentor engineering talent, and deliver end-to-end resilient back-end and distributed messaging solutions. You will champion engineering excellence, modern DevOps practices, and cloud-native containerized delivery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Technical Leadership & Architecture
  
  

* Lead the technical design, system decomposition, and development of mission-critical microservices and event-driven architectures.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Infrastructure teams to ensure alignment with organizational blueprints, compliance benchmarks, and engineering standards.
* Own technical governance, including architectural reviews, coding standards, automated testing frameworks, and non-functional requirements (resilience, scalability, low latency, fault tolerance).

Hands-on Engineering & Delivery
  
  

* Design and implement robust, high-performance back-end services using Core Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIs.
* Build and optimize event streaming and message-oriented middleware patterns using Apache Kafka and IBM MQ / JMS.
* Architect and tune high-volume data persistence layers across relational databases (Oracle) and NoSQL document stores (MongoDB).
* Drive containerization and deployment strategies targeting modern enterprise cloud platforms (ECS / Red Hat OpenShift).

Engineering Excellence & Mentorship
  
  

* Conduct rigorous code reviews, enforce unit/integration test coverage standards, and eliminate technical debt.
* Mentor and coach junior and mid-level developers, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) and performance troubleshooting for complex production incidents and distributed system bottlenecks.

Agile & DevOps Collaboration
  
  

* Drive end-to-end CI/CD automation, shift-left security (SAST/DAST, dependency scanning), and containerized deployments.
* Work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and Business Stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum delivery model to translate complex business requirements into clear technical roadmaps and epics.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**
Education & Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related discipline.
* 10+ years of total software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a technical leadership or module lead capacity.

**Primary (Core) Skills & Competencies**

* Core Java & Frameworks: Deep expertise in Java (Java 11 / 17 / 21), Concurrency, Multithreading, JVM internals, Memory Management, and Garbage Collection tuning.
* Spring Ecosystem: Comprehensive experience with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud).
* API & Integration: Extensive experience designing and developing RESTful Web Services, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, and contract-driven API patterns.
* Messaging & Event Streaming: Strong hands-on implementation experience with Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, fault handling) and enterprise message queues (IBM MQ / JMS).
* Database Engineering: Relational: Oracle DB (complex SQL, PL/SQL, schema design, index tuning, transaction isolation). NoSQL: MongoDB (data modeling, indexing strategies, aggregation pipelines, performance tuning).
* Design Patterns & Clean Code: Strong grounding in SOLID principles, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Distributed Transactions, Sagas, and Microservices design patterns.

Secondary Skills & Familiarity (Highly Desirable)
  
  

* Containerization & Platforms: Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and enterprise container platforms such as ECS / Red Hat OpenShift.
* Frontend / Full-Stack Exposure: Familiarity with modern frontend development using Angular, React JS.
* Business Process Management: Exposure to enterprise workflow engines such as IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) / BPM.
* Application Servers & Middleware: Understanding of legacy or hybrid runtime environments including IBM WebSphere Application Server (WAS / Liberty).
* CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of modern deployment pipelines, Jenkins/Tekton/Harness, Git, Maven/Gradle, and code quality tools (SonarQube, Snyk).

Leadership & Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Problem Solving: Exceptional analytical and debugging skills with a proven track record of resolving complex distributed systems challenges.
* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate technical tradeoffs to non-technical business partners.
* Ownership & Drive: Demonstrated ability to independently lead engineering initiatives from ideation to production rollout.
* Collaboration: High team spirit and emotional intelligence to work across globally distributed engineering teams.

title: Software Quality Engineer – Automation & AI
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Film and Scatterometry Technology (FaST) division delivers industry-leading metrology solutions essential to advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its portfolio includes systems for measuring film thickness, critical dimensions, composition, and resistivity—key to developing and scaling next-gen IC processes. FaST partners closely with customers from early R&D through high-volume production, ensuring performance and process alignment.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Qualify new and existing software products and features through functional, regression, performance, reliability, and system-level testing.
* Design, develop, and execute test plans, test cases, and validation strategies to ensure high product quality.
* Analyze test results and publish qualification reports, recommendations, training materials, and Best Known Methods (BKMs).
* Collaborate with Algorithm, System Engineering, Applications Engineering, Product Management, Manufacturing, Marketing, and Customer Support teams across global locations.
* Assess automation feasibility and develop automated test solutions, frameworks, and tools to improve test coverage and efficiency.
* Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design reviews, deployment, troubleshooting, and customer support.

**AI & Innovation Responsibilities**

* Leverage Generative AI and AI-powered tools to improve test design, execution, defect analysis, reporting, and documentation.
* Develop AI-enabled utilities, applications, and productivity tools for engineering and quality workflows.
* Explore and implement solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and modern AI frameworks.
* Drive AI adoption within the SQE organization by identifying, prototyping, and deploying high-impact use cases.
* Utilize AI and data analytics techniques to improve quality insights, root cause analysis, and engineering productivity.

**Desired Skills**

* Strong programming skills in Python, C#, C++, or Java.
* Experience with software testing, automation frameworks, and quality engineering methodologies.
* Exposure to AI/ML concepts, Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, AI agents, or AI application development is preferred.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Additional Requirements**

* Represent SQE in product lifecycle reviews, key program meetings, and cross-functional initiatives.
* Willingness to travel to customer fabrication facilities for use-case understanding, software deployment, and troubleshooting support as required.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*
