**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
As we modernize our Middleware platforms, we are also transforming the way we deliver and support them. With a strategic shift toward 100% Infrastructure as Code (IaC), we are building a fully automated, scalable, and resilient delivery model. To support this evolution, we are seeking skilled Automation Test Engineers who can rigorously validate and certify our infrastructure code ensuring it is defect-free, reliable, and aligned with our IaC goals. This role will focus on validating middleware components (e.g., Tomcat, MQ, WebSphere) through automated test frameworks, ensuring configuration integrity, and supporting continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts for middleware platforms using tools such as Chef InSpec, Jenkins, Ansible and custom frameworks
* Validate middleware configurations across environments (on-prem and cloud) based on infrastructure standards
* Collaborate with Product DRIs, Automation Developers, and Infrastructure teams to translate requirements into testable automation scenarios
* Maintain and enhance test coverage for regression, integration, and system validation across Tomcat, MQ, WAS, and RDQM
* Analyze test results, log defects, and work with engineering teams to resolve issues.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to backlog grooming and sprint planning.
* Support Day 2 operations testing and readiness validation for middleware deployments

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 4 years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

**Talents Needed For Success**

* 3+ years of QA Testing experience with at least 2 years hands on Test Automation Experience
* Experience using Java, TestNG, JUnit, and Selenium.
* Hands-on experience with Git and Bitbucket is needed.
* Thorough Understanding of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)
* Proficient in all phases of testing including planning, design, execution, defect tracking, and reporting
* Skilled in designing, developing, and executing automated test scripts using tools such as Chef InSpec, Jenkins, Ansible, and custom-built frameworks
* Familiar with Git for source code management and experienced in setting up Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to streamline test automation workflows Knowledge of automation standard and best practices including experience with XPath axes and CSS selectors
* Should know the Defect Management using ALM and Agile/Scrum management through JIRA, Defect Triaging, Defect Status Reporting and Tracking
* Develop, maintain, and implement functional and automated test scripts using Java and testing frameworks.
* Sound knowledge of regression testing, Smoke & Sanity testing, compatibility testing, system functional testing, user acceptance testing etc.
* Experience in build tools such as Maven, adding dependencies, maintaining pom.xml file is required.
* Ability to write simple to medium complexity SQL queries.
* Ability to interpret technical designs and specifications and design automated solutions accordingly.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Positive relationship and collaboration skills.

Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Data Product Engineer

A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Data Product Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and operating scalable, reusable, and trusted data products that power business intelligence, advanced analytics, AI/ML solutions, and operational decision-making. This role combines modern data engineering practices with product thinking to build high-quality data assets that are discoverable, governed, and reusable across the enterprise. The engineer partners with business stakeholders, product managers, architects, data scientists, and platform teams to deliver data products that align with strategic business outcomes.

title: Process & Requirements Analyst - VP
description:
Join us as a “
**Process & Requirements Analyst-VP**
” and help us deliver a simpler, better and more balanced experience for our colleagues and leaders across the world.
  
  
As the Process & Requirements Analyst, you will play a critical role in transforming the bank through disciplined business analysis, requirements management and process design across complex change initiatives. You will independently facilitate stakeholder discussions, capture and translate complex business needs into clear documentation, map current-state journeys and shape practical future-state designs. You will identify pain points, dependencies and testing scenarios, and translate business requirements into functional requirements for technology delivery teams. Working confidently with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams, you will simplify ambiguity, challenge assumptions and maintain end-to-end traceability from business need through design, configuration, validation and testing. You will also partner with Change and Training leads to ensure launch collateral connects the new solution to the agreed requirements and intended benefits.
  
  
To be successful as a “Process & Requirements Analyst-VP”, you should have experience with:
  
  
**Required Skills**

* Critical Reasoning, Curiosity & Attention to Detail: Must have strong analytical skills, be specific, tenacious, curious and quick to learn, with a focus on crystallizing requirements and problem statements. Should be proactive, ask the right questions, probe for clarity, and move at pace. You can look across requirements, connecting the dots across a broad set of requirements, to support creation of a coherent design solution.
* Business Analysis and Requirements Management: Independently facilitates complex stakeholder discussions, captures and analyses business needs, and translates them into clear, prioritised and traceable business and functional requirements.
* Process Mapping and Improvement: Creates clear current-state and future-state process maps, identifies pain points, dependencies and improvement opportunities, and uses tools such as Blueworks, Visio or comparable process mapping applications.
* Ability to work in dynamic, fast paced, agile environment. You are a really fast learner, understanding different information quickly, assimilating new information and being able to represent that clearly and coherently, in a manner that others, not involved, can understand.
* You are solutions oriented, credible with colleagues, People Leaders and senior leaders able to work across centres of excellence, colleague support, HR tech and the journey experience team, creating one coherent, aligned set of requirements and designs.
* Technology Change and Governance: Uses Jira to manage requirements, traceability, governance and version control across design, build and testing activities, and works effectively with technology delivery teams.
* Testing and User Acceptance: Defines realistic positive and negative test scenarios from requirements and process analysis, understands key dependencies and supports thorough user acceptance testing.
* Strategic Requirements Leadership: Translates strategic objectives into clear business outcomes, capability needs and prioritised requirements, ensuring alignment across multiple initiatives and stakeholder groups.
* Senior Stakeholder Management and Influencing: Builds trusted relationships with senior leaders, constructively challenges assumptions, facilitates evidence-based decisions and secures alignment where priorities or perspectives differ.
* Portfolio Prioritisation and Dependency Management: Assesses value, urgency, risk and delivery complexity to support prioritisation, while identifying and managing cross-functional dependencies, constraints and impacts.
* Risk, Controls and Design Governance: Embeds risk and control considerations into requirements and solution design, establishes clear decision records and traceability, and ensures appropriate governance throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Benefits and Outcome Focus: Defines measurable outcomes and acceptance criteria, links requirements to intended benefits and uses evidence to confirm that delivered solutions address the original business need.

**Additional Skills**

* Business English and Multinational Experience: Highly experienced in writing detailed specifications in business English and working with global stakeholders; experience supporting United Kingdom-based teams is highly desirable. Experience in Human Resources, Workday or process transformation environments is also desirable.

**Leadership Capabilities**

* Lead Through Ambiguity: Provides structure and direction in complex or uncertain situations, makes sound decisions with incomplete information and maintains momentum while key issues are resolved.
* Cross-functional Leadership: Leads virtual and cross-functional teams through discovery, design and validation activities, clarifying accountabilities and creating an environment in which challenge and collaboration are encouraged.
* Decision Facilitation and Conflict Resolution: Surfaces trade-offs, resolves competing priorities and facilitates timely decisions, escalating material risks or unresolved issues with clear options and recommendations.
* Coaching and Capability Building: Coaches analysts and delivery colleagues, sets quality standards, provides constructive feedback and shares practical methods that strengthen requirements and process analysis capability.
* Executive Communication: Communicates complex information in a concise and compelling way, tailoring messages for senior audiences and presenting clear insights, impacts, recommendations and decisions required.
* Accountability for Delivery Quality: Sets expectations for quality, pace and governance, monitors progress and intervenes early to address gaps, ensuring requirements remain coherent, testable and aligned to agreed outcomes.

**Basic/ Essential Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree

You may be assessed on critical reasoning, business analysis, requirements management, process mapping, stakeholder engagement, change and transformation, risk and controls, business acumen, strategic thinking, and digital and technology skills. Assessment may include a process-flow exercise or case-study discussion focused on gathering requirements, structuring delivery activities, managing stakeholders and supporting project execution.
  
  
This role will primarily be based in Chennai, India, with Pune accepted as a secondary location.
  
  
Core hours for this role are 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM IST, with flexibility required for key afternoon meetings. There is a policy to attend the office 3 days in a week on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday of every week.
  
  
  

* Purpose of the role

To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

description:
**Business Consultant | Scrum Master**

Website Ecommerce and Data Delivery and MSO

**Full-time | Chennai | On-site | Immediate Joiner | U.S Overlapping Hours**

**Role Overview:**

CXOntology seeks a hands-on Business Consultant and Scrum Master to lead business analysis, sprint delivery, and Maintenance, Support and Operations (MSO) across enterprise websites, ecommerce, and data programs. Turn business problems into clear backlogs, coordinate multiple workstreams, and own client delivery commitments.

**Our platforms include Drupal/Acquia, Optimizely, Sitecore, AEM, Contentstack, Shopify, BigCommerce, and commercetools,**
with data integrations using Snowflake and Informatica.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Business Analysis and Sprint Delivery**

* Lead discovery and root-cause analysis. Map processes, journeys, data flows, and business rules; validate assumptions and compare solution options with stakeholders.
* Write epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and nonfunctional requirements. Maintain traceability through testing, UAT, and business acceptance.
* Facilitate
  **backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily Scrum, reviews, and retrospectives**
  . Agree priorities, capacity, sprint goals, and a Definition of Done; resolve blockers and track improvement actions.
* Coordinate dependencies, scope changes, release readiness, and support handovers across workstreams. Make delivery risks and decisions visible early.

**ServiceNow and Jira Configuration**

* Configure
  **ServiceNow ITSM**
  incident, problem, change, and request processes, including service catalogs, routing, approvals, notifications, SLAs, and knowledge workflows.
* Customize ServiceNow forms, fields, UI policies, business rules, client scripts, and flows. Test changes, control access, and promote releases through managed environments.
* Configure
  **Jira and Jira Service Management**
  projects, boards, workflows, fields, permissions, automation, queues, and SLAs. Build reports using advanced JQL, dashboards, and ServiceNow reporting; troubleshoot API integrations with engineers.

**MSO and Account Management**

* Balance sprint commitments with production support. Coordinate incident communications, root-cause reviews, corrective actions, and service improvements.
* Manage scope, capacity, account health, and effort or budget variances. Lead client discussions, resolve competing priorities, and issue concise program updates with owners, dates, risks, and decisions needed.

**Performance and Business Outcomes**

* Review blockers, backlog aging, and SLA risks daily or weekly; assess sprint goals, scope completion, cycle time, throughput, and escaped defects each sprint.
* Run monthly service and outcome reviews covering SLA attainment, response/restoration time, recurring incidents, change success, and stakeholder satisfaction. Track adoption, conversion, productivity, cost, or data quality against agreed baselines, targets, and benefit owners; consolidate quarterly business reviews.

**Required Skills and Experience:**

* **7+ years**
  in business analysis, consulting, Scrum, or service delivery, with ownership of concurrent client workstreams and live MSO engagements.
* Expert
  **hands-on ServiceNow and Jira**
  experience. Show what you personally configured, customized, automated, and reported, with delivery or service results.
* Deep project experience in
  **at least one**
  core service area: CMS websites (Drupal/Acquia, Optimizely, Sitecore, AEM, Contentstack); ecommerce (Shopify, BigCommerce, commercetools); or data (Snowflake, Informatica IICS, Boomi, Talend, AWS, Power BI, Cognos).
* Understand website publishing, storefronts, or data pipelines and reconciliation in your specialist area. Learn adjacent platforms, including connected MarTech and analytics such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, GA4, and GTM.
* Strong logical analysis and data validation using Excel, SQL where relevant, and Power BI or comparable tools. Understand APIs, testing, release governance, and ITSM.
* Confident facilitation with clients and internal teams. Listen, challenge assumptions constructively, coach collaboration, and follow commitments through to closure. Learn new technology through practical use.

**Certifications:**

* **Required:**
  recognized Scrum Master certification, such as CSM or PSM, backed by delivery experience.
* **Preferred:**
  ITIL, ServiceNow, Atlassian, Product Owner, business analysis, or relevant platform certification.

**Success in the Role**

Clear backlogs, predictable sprint delivery, dependable live services, and measurable business benefits. Reports use reliable data and lead to agreed decisions and completed improvement actions.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
As a Software Engineering Manager within MS TECH Order Fulfillment, you will provide strategic product and technical leadership, along with hands-on expertise, to build industry-leading products. You are a systems thinker capable of driving large-scale transformations that maximize value for Ford, our Dealers, and our customers. The role combines high-level strategy, including product vision, AI/ML use-case portfolio, data strategy, and technical roadmaps, with disciplined execution to deliver scalable, resilient, secure, explainable, and highly available solutions in a global environment.
  
  
**Technical Leadership & Vision**

* Serve as the primary technical authority for the Order Generation product suite, defining the evolution of the technology stack, data architecture, AI/ML capabilities, and architectural patterns.
* Lead cross-functional teams through complex integrations, managing dependencies across the broader Order Fulfillment ecosystem to ensure seamless data flow and system interoperability.
* Translate high-level business requirements into actionable technical strategies that align with Ford enterprise standards.

**AI/ML Product Strategy & Innovation**

* Define and execute an AI/ML and data analytics product strategy that converts priority business requirements into a sequenced portfolio of intelligent capabilities and measurable outcomes.
* Identify, evaluate, and prioritize AI/ML opportunities across forecasting, order generation, decision support, anomaly detection, optimization, and workflow automation using value, feasibility, risk, data readiness, and adoption criteria.
* Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI/ML products from discovery, business-case development, experimentation, and MVP validation through industrialization, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, Product, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Legal, Privacy, and business teams to ensure solutions are technically sound, usable, compliant, and aligned with responsible AI principles.
* Establish outcome-based product metrics, experimentation methods, model performance targets, and adoption measures; use evidence and customer feedback to guide investment and roadmap decisions.
* Monitor emerging technologies, including generative AI, agentic AI, foundation models, advanced analytics, optimization, and intelligent automation, and determine where they can create differentiated business value.
* Drive build, buy, or partner assessments and develop scalable patterns for reusable AI/ML services, data products, model APIs, and decision intelligence capabilities.

**Product Strategy & Delivery**

* Partner with business stakeholders to define and execute a multi-year product vision and roadmap focused on optimized order forecasting and generation.
* Champion an iterative, Agile delivery model, prioritizing the delivery of Minimum Viable Products (MVPs) and maintaining a high-velocity release cadence.
* Apply Human-Centered Design (HCD) principles to ensure technical solutions solve real-world problems for Dealers and customers.
* Create launch and adoption plans that include operational readiness, user training, change management, benefit tracking, and feedback loops.

**Data, Model & MLOps Excellence**

* Ensure AI/ML solutions are supported by trusted, governed, discoverable, and fit-for-purpose data, with clear ownership, lineage, quality controls, and access patterns.
* Guide the implementation of robust MLOps and LLMOps practices covering reproducible experimentation, model registry, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, retraining, rollback, and auditability.
* Define controls for model quality, explainability, bias and fairness evaluation, privacy, security, human oversight, and responsible use throughout the product lifecycle.
* Balance predictive accuracy with interpretability, latency, cost, reliability, and business usability when selecting models and architectures.

**Engineering & Operational Excellence**

* Enforce rigorous engineering standards, including Test-Driven Development (TDD), robust CI/CD pipelines, and DevSecOps practices.
* Drive a culture of Full Lifecycle Ownership, where the team is responsible for the design, security, deployment, and operational health of its services.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for system health, code quality, delivery velocity, model performance, data quality, adoption, and realized business value.

**Architectural Design**

* Architect and oversee the development of cloud-native, microservices-based systems designed for global scale, multi-tenancy, and high-performance transactional processing.
* Design interoperable data and AI architectures that support batch and real-time inference, event-driven workflows, APIs, observability, and secure integration with enterprise platforms.

**People Leadership & Talent Development**

* Cultivate a high-performing, diverse team of Software Engineers, Product Managers, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and ML Engineers through active coaching, mentorship, and career pathing.
* Foster a culture of psychological safety and continuous learning, utilizing blameless retrospectives and regular feedback loops to drive team growth.
* Identify and close skill gaps within the team to keep pace with emerging technologies and industry trends.

**Strategic Collaboration**

* Act as a bridge between the product team and domain experts in Cloud Infrastructure, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, Responsible AI, SRE, and DevOps to reduce portfolio complexity.
* Influence stakeholders across the organization to adopt modern engineering practices, responsible AI controls, reusable data products, and standardized service contracts.

**Technical Execution (Hands-on)**

* Maintain deep technical fluency in the team’s primary languages, frameworks, cloud services, data platforms, and AI/ML toolchain, including Java, Spring Boot, GCP/Azure, Vertex AI, and modern MLOps platforms.
* Lead from the front by participating in architecture and code reviews, resolving complex technical blockers, reviewing model and data design decisions, and occasionally prototyping high-risk or emerging technology concepts.
* Experience: 10+ years of progressive software engineering, digital product, data, or AI/ML solution delivery experience, with a significant portion in engineering and product leadership roles.
* AI/ML Product Leadership: Demonstrated experience strategizing, developing, launching, and scaling AI/ML-based products that address business requirements and deliver measurable operational or customer outcomes.
* Product Strategy: Experience defining product vision, business cases, roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, MVPs, go-to-market or launch plans, adoption strategies, and value-realization metrics for data and AI products.
* Education: Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.
* Certifications: Industry certifications relevant to software engineering, cloud, data, or AI/ML, or a commitment to obtain them within 6 months. GCP Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Machine Learning Engineer, or equivalent certification is a plus.
* Cloud Expertise: 4+ years of experience delivering production solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including cloud-native application and data/AI services.
* Technical Depth: Expertise in microservices, cloud-native architectures, event-driven architectures, APIs, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), distributed systems, and secure enterprise integration.
* AI/ML & Analytics: Strong working knowledge of supervised and unsupervised learning, time-series forecasting, optimization, anomaly detection, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, and production inference patterns.
* Data Engineering: Experience with data architectures, data pipelines, data quality, governance, metadata and lineage, feature stores, batch and streaming data, and analytics platforms.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Hands-on experience establishing or governing CI/CD/CT for models, experiment tracking, model registry, automated validation, deployment, observability, drift monitoring, retraining, and lifecycle controls.
* Responsible AI: Experience applying secure and responsible AI practices, including privacy, transparency, explainability, bias and fairness assessment, human oversight, access controls, risk management, and auditability.
* Technology Stack: Hands-on experience with Java, Angular, Python, SQL, Terraform, Postgres, APIGEE, Kubernetes, Docker, serverless technologies, and containerization. Experience with Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, or equivalent cloud services is strongly preferred.
* Engineering Excellence: Thorough knowledge of multi-threading, concurrency, parallel processing, DevSecOps, test automation, and monitoring tools such as Dynatrace or Google Cloud Monitoring.
* Developer Experience: Experience increasing developer productivity by integrating AI agents, coding assistants, reusable platform capabilities, or AI skills into the development lifecycle.
* Leadership Qualities: Proven ability to lead large-scale transformations, apply systems thinking, create psychologically safe teams, influence complex decisions, and earn the respect of strong individual technical talent through competence and mentorship.
* Communication & Business Acumen: Ability to communicate complex technical and AI concepts to executives and business partners, align diverse stakeholders, manage trade-offs, and connect product investments to business outcomes.

**Nice to Have**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related field.
* Experience with Vertex AI, BigQuery, Feature Store, Gemini or other foundation-model platforms, vector search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, and evaluation frameworks.
* Experience building reusable enterprise platforms and underlying services for data, analytics, and AI capabilities.
* Experience with forecasting, supply chain, order fulfillment, demand planning, optimization, or decision intelligence products.
* Ability to translate product roadmaps into manageable features through quarterly scoping sessions and assist product teams directly with technical blockers.
* Proven ability to identify and mitigate delivery, data, model, security, adoption, and operational risks while assessing overall product health and prompting timely decisions.
* Strong understanding of business priorities and technical feasibility to prioritize platform backlogs and manage dependencies.
* Experience with Lean methodology, eXtreme Programming (XP), Agile product management, and Human-Centered Design.
* Experience championing modern software, data, AI/ML, product, and responsible AI practices within a large organization.

title: Project Leader
description:

Agile Delivery & Release Management
  
  

* Manage and coordinate the Agile Release Train (ART) to ensure successful and predictable delivery of committed objectives.

* Monitor current release work items and ensure alignment with release milestones and delivery commitments.
* Review and manage delivery risks, dependencies, and escalation paths to maintain program health.

* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to identify, track, and resolve delivery blockers and cross-team dependencies.

* Organize, facilitate, and drive regular defect triage and tracking meetings.

* Escalate critical issues appropriately and drive resolution through collaboration with stakeholders and leadership.
* Maintain visibility of program risks and mitigation plans.

Tool and Process Management
  
  

* Manage and maintain Agile work items, backlogs, features, user stories, tasks, and defects within Azure DevOps (ADO).

* Proven experience managing multiple Agile teams and coordinating large-scale releases.
* Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) for work item tracking, backlog management, and reporting.
* Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, communication, and conflict resolution skills.
* Strong risk management and dependency coordination skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE), SAFe Agilist, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PMI-ACP, or equivalent Agile certification.

title: Implementation Senior Analyst
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
  
  
The
**Senior Analyst**
is responsible for leading complex, customer-facing technical projects from discovery through delivery. This role partners closely with clients and internal teams to define scope, shape implementation strategy, manage day-to-day execution, and ensure successful outcomes across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong project management and client communication skills with enough technical depth to support data analysis, troubleshooting, and scripting work as needed. This role requires someone who can confidently lead critical customer conversations, manage expectations, navigate ambiguity, and drive progress in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Team Summary
  
  
The team supports customer-facing technical project delivery, implementation execution, and cross-functional coordination across internal and external stakeholders. Team members work together to manage complex engagements, resolve issues, support delivery quality, and improve customer outcomes.
  
  
The environment values clear communication, accountability, collaboration, and the ability to move between project management, data analysis, and technical problem-solving as needed.
  
  
**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end technical projects, including discovery, scoping, planning, execution, testing, implementation, and post-go-live support.
* Own customer-facing project conversations, including strategy sessions, status updates, risk management discussions, issue resolution, and executive-level stakeholder communication.
* Drive project scoping and strategy by translating customer needs into clear requirements, timelines, deliverables, and execution plans.
* Manage day-to-day project operations, including timelines, dependencies, action items, escalations, and cross-functional coordination.
* Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to align on goals, priorities, assumptions, and implementation approach.
* Analyze and validate data to support project decisions, troubleshoot issues, and confirm successful delivery.
* Write and maintain SQL queries to extract, validate, reconcile, and analyze data as needed.
* Develop Python scripts or utilities to streamline analysis, automate repetitive work, or support technical troubleshooting.
* Identify technical, operational, and data-related risks early and drive mitigation plans.
* Resolve complex issues involving data discrepancies, workflow mismatches, integration challenges, or process breakdowns.
* Document project scope, requirements, decisions, risks, and outcomes in a clear and organized manner.
* Work closely with engineering, product, operations, and client teams to unblock issues and ensure delivery.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities while maintaining high-quality execution.
* Recommend process improvements and contribute to scalable delivery methods and operational excellence.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them navigate technical complexity and make informed implementation decisions.
* Support onboarding or mentoring of teammates on project process, technical workflows, and best practices.
* Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis, support scripting and troubleshooting, and improve project documentation while applying human judgment to verify outputs.
* Perform other duties as assigned to support team objectives and customer success.

**Additional Job Responsibilities**

* Contribute to process improvements that strengthen delivery consistency and operational excellence.
* Support collaboration across distributed teams and time zones.
* Assist in maintaining effective project reporting, tracking, and communication practices.
* Participate in knowledge sharing and best-practice development across the team.
* Help support scalable methods for managing complex customer-facing technical work.

Expected Education & Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, science, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in technical project management, implementation, healthcare IT, and data migration.
* Strong experience managing customer-facing technical engagements and critical stakeholder conversations.
* Proven ability to drive scoping, planning, and strategy for complex technical projects.
* Hands-on experience managing projects end to end in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency in SQL for data querying, validation, reconciliation, and analysis.
* Experience with Python scripting for automation, data handling, or technical analysis is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines independently.
* Comfort working with distributed teams across geographies and time zones.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other standard project or data tools.
* Experience with Salesforce, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar tools is a plus.
* Ability to adapt quickly, operate with urgency, and thrive in a collaborative environment.
* Experience in US healthcare, health IT, or EHR-related work is required.
* PMP certification is an added advantage.

title: Technical Lead, Software Development
description:
**Company Overview**
KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
  
  
**Group/Division**
With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Surfscan group includes a team of engineers, technology development, apps engineers and product marketing focused on technology that enables wafer, IC and equipment manufacturers to develop, qualify and monitor their process tools. Defects and process non-uniformities detected on Surfscan equipment allow for early identification of yield excursions. The flagship Surfscan products include the SPx platforms for wafer surface quality and wafer defect inspection tools and systems for inspection of polished wafers, epi wafers and engineered substrates during the wafer fabrication process.
  
  
**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
**Role**
:
  
  
Lead Software Engineer position to work on SFS division's SPx products based on Common software platform.

* Acquire and demonstrate technical knowledge of Surfscan software.

* Understand and make design and architectural improvements on existing software.
* Participate in requirements definition and review process. Provide Technical assessment of the impact of any changes to product requirements.
* Providing technical expertise to the estimation process as input to the project plan
* Acquire knowledge of key use cases in Bare wafer inspection (IC & Wafer customers)
* Follow KT defined software development processes
* Lead small teams to develop key features on need basis.
* In conjunction with the Technical Manager, identify, highlight, review and mitigate technical risks
* Contributes to the continued improvement of the organization’s development procedures, by looking for opportunities for improvement and proposing ideas for solution.

**Requirements**
:
  
  
Strong in programming fundamentals, C++, VC++, MFC and COM.
  
  
Experience in Architecting systems from scratch, leading project teams.
  
  
Diverse Experience in analysis, design, development and unit testing
  
  
Thorough knowledge of SDLC and software engineering
  
  
Must be able to interact and communicate with all levels of staff and project management in both the business and the technical areas, with the ability to keep discussions at the appropriate level of abstraction.
  
  
Possess excellent analytical, problem solving, organizational, interpersonal, and motivational skills, with the ability to move cleanly from theoretical to implementation thinking.
  
  
Willingness to travel to US and other customer places on short assignments.
  
  
**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience in developing COM/DCOM using MFC/ATL
* Experience in .Net and C#.
* Knowledge in STL, Boost Library, WinDBG and Windows Internals.
* Knowledge of CMM or other process models
* Knowledge of KT specific or general semiconductor domain

**Minimum Qualifications**
**Qualifications**
:
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer science / Electronics / Electrical or equivalent field with 6+ years of experience with large software systems and/or semiconductor products
  
  
(Or)
  
  
Master's degree in Computer science / Electronics / Electrical or equivalent field with 4+ years of experience with large software systems and/or semiconductor products

title: Technology Manager
description:
**About Revolut**
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
  
  
As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.
  
  
We're looking for a Technology Manager to make sure our IT changes and tech ecosystem are safe and well-managed. You'll be working closely with our Operations and Product teams to keep projects on track. We need a brilliant problem solver who's passionate about IT systems and networks.
  
  
Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Assessing initiatives that require IT changes
* Identifying dependencies, impact, and risks, and making sure they're properly analysed, tested, and managed
* Representing the Technology team in larger change and transformation programmes, and taking ownership of relevant tasks
* Building and optimising scalable processes to support Revolut's hyper-growth
* Leading and executing projects end to end

**What You'll Need**

* 7+ years of experience in financial services or fintech, or at a leading technology or IT services provider

* A solid grasp of technology within a financial services organisation, including modern tech stacks

* Technology and change delivery experience at a leading global consultancy

title: Engineer II, System validation Test - Insight QA
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for an Engineer II in System Validation Testing with 3 to 5 years of experience to join our cloud network management quality engineering team. The role focuses on hands-on testing of a cloud-hosted platform used to onboard, configure, monitor and manage networking devices such as access points, switches and routers.
  
  
The engineer will work with senior QA engineers, developers and product teams to understand requirements, design and execute tests, automate repeatable workflows, investigate failures and contribute to reliable releases across the device, network, cloud, API and web or mobile application layers.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Cloud Network Management Testing
  
  

* Understand feature requirements and expected customer workflows for cloud-managed access points, switches and routers.
* Test device onboarding, discovery, provisioning, configuration and removal workflows.
* Validate device-to-cloud communication, cloud-to-device operations and configuration synchronization.
* Test device status, statistics, alerts, notifications and basic remote-management workflows.
* Validate firmware upgrade, reconnect, recovery and factory-reset scenarios under guidance.
* Execute tests across common LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi and multi-device network setups.

Test Planning and Execution
  
  

* Review user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications with the QA team.
* Create and maintain clear test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative, boundary and recovery conditions.
* Prepare test data and configure required devices, accounts, subscriptions and environments.
* Execute functional, integration, system, regression, compatibility and end-to-end tests.
* Record results accurately, report coverage gaps and escalate blockers early.
* Retest resolved defects and run focused regression for impacted workflows.

API Cloud and Data Validation
  
  

* Test REST APIs using tools such as Postman and automation libraries.
* Validate request and response data, status codes, authentication, authorization and error handling.
* Verify consistency across APIs, backend services, database records and user interfaces.
* Test asynchronous operations, events and notifications with support from senior engineers.
* Use AWS logs, dashboards and application telemetry to investigate test failures.

description:

From the moment a consumer is thinking of placing an order, to the time the order arrives at their door and a review is posted to social media, Foodhub has solutions to drive the consumer experience, whilst adding extra value via our ecosystem of partners. The Foodhub Tech Stack is extensive: from Web and Mobile Ordering to 3rd Party Order Aggregation, Dispatch and Self-Delivery, complete Hardware/Software POS systems, extensive array of POS integrations, On-Premise Kiosks, QR Code Ordering and Payment, Table-side Mobile Order/Receipt Printers, plus an extensive product and development team to support all of this.

* Contribute to and influence the mobile architecture, including state management, navigation, offline behavior, modularization and native bridges.

* Implement and maintain robust automated testing using Jest, React Native Testing Library and end-to-end frameworks such as Detox or Maestro.
* Own and improve mobile CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Fast lane, EAS Build, App Center or equivalent.
* Lead code reviews with a strong focus on quality, security, accessibility and maintainability.
* Establish and maintain project-level AI context configurations and coding standards documentation.
* Mentor mid-level and junior engineers on React Native, TypeScript, mobile best practices and the responsible use of AI development tools.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Backend, QA and EPOS/POS teams to translate business requirements into well-scoped technical solutions.
* Contribute to engineering standards, documentation, technical specifications and the continuous improvement of team processes.

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with emerging standards such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and the integration of AI tooling into developer workflows is desirable.

**Requirements**
Qualifications
  
  

* Minimum 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* At least 5 years of hands-on production experience building React Native applications in TypeScript.
* Demonstrable experience shipping and maintaining mobile applications that are live on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

**Required Skills**

* Strong, advanced-level TypeScript skills, including strict mode, generics, discriminated unions, utility types and disciplined API typing.
* Practical experience with the React Native New Architecture (Fabric, TurboModules, JSI) and the Hermes JavaScript engine.
* Deep understanding of React Native internals, including the bridge, lifecycle, rendering pipeline, reconciliation and threading model.
* Experience writing or extending native modules in Swift (iOS) and Kotlin (Android).
* Proficiency with modern state management approaches such as Redux Toolkit, Zustand, Jotai, MobX or React Query.
* Strong working knowledge of React Navigation, including deep linking, universal links, App Links and complex navigation patterns.
* Experience with offline-first architectures, secure local storage, push notifications, background tasks and OTA updates.
* Hands-on experience with mobile CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Fast lane, EAS Build, Bitrise or App Center.
* Strong testing discipline using Jest, React Native Testing Library and at least one end-to-end framework.
* Solid understanding of REST and/or GraphQL API integration, authentication flows and secure communication on mobile.
* Working knowledge of mobile application security best practices.
* Proficiency with Git and modern branching workflows.
* Daily, hands-on use of AI coding assistants as a core part of the development workflow.

title: Finacle Product Engineer | Selenium, Java & Retail Assets Production Support
description:
****Job Summary****
Synechron is seeking a
**Finacle Product Engineer**
with
**5+ years of experience**
in test automation, production support, defect management, and banking technology. The role will support Retail Assets applications by resolving automation defects and production business incidents, improving application stability, and expanding test automation coverage.The position will contribute to business objectives by reducing recurring defects, improving release quality, supporting production continuity, coordinating defect fixes and upgrades, and strengthening the reliability of Retail Assets and lending operations across multiple entities.
  
  
****Required****
**Software Requirements**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in software testing, test automation, production support, application support, or related technology roles.

* Experience designing, developing, maintaining, and executing automated test scripts.

* Experience with production support, incident management, defect tracking, and issue resolution.

* Familiarity with defect tracking, test management, release management, and collaboration tools.
* Experience coordinating with development, testing, business, and operations teams.
* Knowledge of software development and testing lifecycle practices.
* Ability to analyze application failures, logs, test results, data issues, and production incidents.
* Strong understanding of defect prioritization, impact assessment, escalation, and resolution tracking.

****Preferred****

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.
* Experience with API automation frameworks and tools.
* Knowledge of Finacle-related applications, Retail Assets, retail lending, loan origination, loan servicing, or lending operations.
* Experience supporting banking applications in production environments.
* Familiarity with automation framework design, reusable components, test data management, and test reporting.
* Experience supporting patches, upgrades, release validation, and regression testing.
* Knowledge of database validation and SQL.
* Familiarity with performance testing, application monitoring, and service reliability practices.
* Experience coordinating testing and stabilization activities across multiple entities or business units.

****Overall Responsibilities****

* Fix and support defect resolution for Retail Assets automation testing and production business incidents.
* Manage production stability by triaging, prioritizing, investigating, and resolving critical incidents.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive measures to reduce recurring defects.

* Develop, maintain, execute, and improve Selenium- and Java-based automated test scripts.
* Drive test stabilization initiatives across multiple entities and application environments.

* Collaborate with business, testing, development, operations, and support teams to improve application quality and reliability.
* Track defects, incidents, resolutions, risks, dependencies, and outstanding actions through appropriate tools.
* Review automation results, production trends, incident patterns, and defect data to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support regression testing, integration testing, system testing, and post-release validation.
* Maintain technical documentation, test evidence, incident records, root-cause reports, and operational procedures.
* Consider security, operational efficiency, maintainability, and responsible use of test infrastructure when designing and executing automation solutions.

****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****

* Java using a current and supported version.
* Strong understanding of Java programming concepts relevant to test automation.
* Ability to create maintainable, reusable, and modular automation code.
* Understanding of exception handling, collections, object-oriented programming, and debugging.
* Ability to read and analyze application code, logs, stack traces, and technical documentation.

****Preferred****

* SQL for data validation and incident investigation.
* Shell scripting for test execution, environment support, and automation tasks.
* Knowledge of scripting languages used in test automation or operational support.

**Databases/Data Management**
****Essential****

* Understanding of relational databases and application data structures.
* Ability to validate test results and production issues using application and database information.
* Understanding of data integrity, data validation, data reconciliation, and test data requirements.
* Ability to analyze data-related defects and support issue investigation.

****Preferred****

* Working knowledge of SQL queries, joins, filters, aggregations, and data comparison.
* Experience validating lending, customer, account, loan, repayment, collateral, or transaction data.
* Familiarity with test data preparation, masking, and controlled use of production-like data.
* Knowledge of data privacy and secure handling of banking information.

**Cloud Technologies**
****Essential****

* Awareness of application environments, infrastructure dependencies, deployment processes, and operational support.
* Understanding of environment availability, configuration, connectivity, monitoring, and access requirements.
* Ability to support testing and incident resolution across distributed application environments.

****Preferred****

* Experience executing automated tests within cloud-based environments.
* Familiarity with cloud-based CI/CD, test execution, monitoring, and logging services.
* Knowledge of cloud access controls, environment configuration, and resource management.
* Awareness of efficient and sustainable use of test and computing resources.

**Frameworks and Libraries**
****Essential****

* Selenium WebDriver for web application automation.
* Java-based test automation frameworks using current and supported versions.
* Experience creating reusable automation components, test suites, page objects, assertions, and test data utilities.
* Understanding of API testing and validation.
* Knowledge of functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing practices.

****Preferred****

* Experience with API automation frameworks and tools.
* Familiarity with test reporting, parallel execution, cross-browser testing, and automation dashboards.
* Experience with behavior-driven or data-driven testing approaches.
* Knowledge of performance, resiliency, or service reliability testing.
* Experience with frameworks used for Finacle, banking, Retail Assets, or lending application validation.

**Development Tools and Methodologies**
****Essential****

* Experience with defect tracking, test management, incident management, and project collaboration tools.
* Knowledge of software testing and development lifecycle practices.
* Experience with test planning, test execution, defect reporting, defect retesting, and regression testing.
* Understanding of Agile development and delivery methodologies.
* Familiarity with version control, code reviews, build processes, and release validation.
* Experience with production incident triage, escalation, communication, resolution, and closure.
* Ability to document root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions.

****Preferred****

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.
* Familiarity with build and dependency management tools.
* Knowledge of test automation reporting, execution scheduling, and failure notification.
* Experience supporting patches, upgrades, deployment activities, and post-release verification.
* Familiarity with application monitoring, log analysis, alerting, and operational dashboards.

**Security Protocols**
****Essential****

* Understanding of secure test data handling and banking data protection requirements.
* Awareness of authentication, authorization, access controls, encryption, and secure connectivity.
* Ability to follow environment access, change management, release, and incident management controls.
* Understanding of confidentiality, data integrity, auditability, and controlled production support practices.

****Preferred****

* Experience testing role-based access controls and authorization scenarios.
* Familiarity with audit logging, data masking, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation.
* Knowledge of security and regulatory considerations relevant to banking and lending applications.
* Experience supporting security validation during patches, upgrades, and releases.

****Experience Requirements****

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in test automation, software testing, production support, application support, or related technology roles.
* Experience developing and maintaining automated tests using Selenium and Java.
* Experience supporting production incidents, defect resolution, root-cause analysis, and application stabilization.
* Experience with API testing, defect tracking, regression testing, and release validation.
* Experience coordinating with development teams on patches, upgrades, fixes, and production deployments.
* Experience working with business, testing, development, and operations stakeholders.
* Experience in the banking domain is required or strongly preferred.
* Experience with Retail Assets, retail lending, lending operations, loan servicing, or related banking processes is preferred.
* Experience supporting applications across multiple entities, environments, or business units is preferred.
* Candidates may also qualify through equivalent practical experience, relevant technical training, certifications, or demonstrated automation and production support outcomes.

**Day-to-Day Activities**

* Develop, execute, maintain, and improve Selenium- and Java-based automation scripts for Retail Assets applications, including regression and release validation testing.
* Triage production incidents and automation failures, analyze logs and test evidence, coordinate with development and business teams, and track issues through resolution.
* Perform root-cause analysis, document corrective actions, monitor recurring defect trends, and contribute to application stabilization and quality improvement initiatives.
* Participate in Agile meetings, incident reviews, release discussions, and stakeholder updates while making testing and support decisions within established quality, security, and change-management standards.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
* Minimum of 5+ years of experience in test automation, software testing, production support, or related technology roles.
* Certifications in software testing, test automation, Agile, Java, or related technologies are preferred.
* Complete Synechron-required training related to information security, data protection, banking applications, workplace conduct, and responsible technology use.
* Maintain continuous professional development in Selenium, Java, API automation, CI/CD, production support, incident management, banking technology, and quality engineering.

**Professional Competencies**

* Critical thinking, technical investigation, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving.
* Effective collaboration with development, testing, business, operations, and support teams.
* Clear communication, stakeholder coordination, incident reporting, and knowledge sharing.
* Adaptability, continuous learning, and effective response to changing production and delivery needs.
* Innovation focused on reusable automation, defect prevention, application stability, and sustainable quality improvements.
* Effective organization, prioritization, time management, and timely resolution of incidents and testing activities.

title: Technology Product Management Lead Analyst - C13 - CHENNAI
description:
We are seeking a collaborative, analytical, and delivery-focused
**Technology Product Management Lead Analyst (C13)**
to support the evolution of Citi's
**Operating Model AI (OMAI)**
platform. This role will serve as a key liaison between Business, Operations, Risk, Controls, Data, AI/Analytics, and Technology teams to deliver scalable solutions that enhance operational transparency, governance, reporting, workflow management, and data-driven decision making across the organization.
  
  
The successful candidate will partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering teams, Business Stakeholders, and End Users to translate strategic objectives into actionable requirements, manage a prioritized backlog, and drive the successful delivery of platform capabilities. The role requires strong product ownership, business analysis, stakeholder management, and Agile execution skills, with the ability to balance business priorities, technology constraints, and governance requirements.
  
  
The ideal candidate must be adaptable, execution-oriented, data-driven, and capable of managing risks, removing impediments, and delivering high-quality outcomes while building strong partnerships across a diverse stakeholder base.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Partner with business stakeholders, product leadership, engineering teams, and end users to define and deliver OMAI platform capabilities.
* Gather, analyze, and document business, process, system, and data requirements.
* Translate business objectives into Epics, Features, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Process Flows.
* Create, prioritize, and maintain a well-groomed product backlog aligned with business priorities.
* Ensure requirements meet Definition of Ready and Definition of Done standards.
* Facilitate workshops, working sessions, demos, and stakeholder reviews to drive alignment and clarity.
* Partner with Agile teams throughout sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and release activities.
* Provide ongoing functional guidance and requirement clarification to development and QA teams.
* Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Data, AI, Operations, Governance, and Risk teams to drive delivery.
* Analyze current-state and future-state processes and identify opportunities for automation, efficiency gains, and workflow optimization.
* Support implementation of AI-enabled capabilities, analytics, reporting enhancements, and workflow automation.
* Validate delivered functionality against business requirements and expected outcomes.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect triage, and release readiness activities.
* Monitor delivery metrics, user feedback, and platform adoption to drive continuous improvement.
* Drive process improvements related to requirements management, Agile execution, prioritization, and delivery governance.
* Act as the voice of the customer while balancing competing business and technology priorities.
* Communicate roadmap updates, risks, dependencies, and delivery progress to stakeholders and leadership.
* Assess and manage risks appropriately, ensuring adherence to applicable policies, controls, and governance standards.

**Recommended Qualifications:**

* 6-10 years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or related Technology roles.
* 5+ years of experience defining and documenting business, managing product backlogs, Epics, Features, User Stories, and Acceptance Criteria.
* Strong experience working in Agile environments utilizing Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or similar methodologies.
* Experience with AI-assisted tools, automation technologies, workflow platforms, and digital transformation initiatives is preferred.
* Experience partnering with Technology, Data, QA, Operations, and Business stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing initiatives, manage multiple workstreams, and successfully deliver complex programs.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence outcomes and drive consensus across multiple teams and organizations.

description:
FE fundinfo is a global leader in investment fund data and technology. We are proud of our vast, diverse, and highly skilled team, who help to make our industry Better Connected and Better Informed.
   

  

 The Client Experience team plays a pivotal role in collaborating with business development and account managers throughout the client's journey. As one of the most substantial divisions at FE fundinfo, the Client Experience department is tasked with the effective execution of projects within the company's portfolio. Encompassing client support, data support, GFRS, managed services and the client success team, our objective is to provide unparalleled client service. The function of Client Experience is to guarantee that our clients receive the utmost value and satisfaction from our products and services.
   

  

 As a Project Quality Specialist you will be responsible for overseeing and supporting the locally based Project Quality team within the Client Delivery Team. The Project Quality Specialist will share knowledge and experience within the team to ensure that the team follows best practices and provide advice where needed.
   

  

 As a Project Quality Specialist you will be responsible for overseeing the Test Phases within projects that are being tested by your Test Team direct reports; thereby ensuring that the client is provided the highest quality assurance.
   

  

 The role will also form part of an operating model for existing services provided to clients. As a Project Quality Specialist you will have a strong test management knowledge and will be able to provide support to other Project Quality Specialists to ensure the highest quality in Integration and System Testing.
   

  

**Your key responsibilities as a Project Quality Specialist will be to:**
* Communicate escalations to manager where appropriate.
* Nurture an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture.
* Continuously develop and optimise team processes to improve overall performance.
* Assist with the preparation of project test plans that outlines the test objectives, schedule, deliverables, test environment setup. It serves as a blueprint for the testing activities and ensures that the team follows a structured approach.
* Collaborate with the test team and project team to create test scenarios and cases that cover all the possible functionalities and requirements of the configured application. They ensure that the test cases are comprehensive and effective and adhere to the test strategy.
* Review test artefacts, such as test cases, test scripts and test data, to ensure their quality, consistency and adherence to the test strategy and plan.
* Consolidate and analyse the findings and prepare comprehensive test reports. These reports highlight the defects found, their severity and the overall quality of the configured application.
* Track and manage defects using a defect tracking system, liaising with developers to resolve defects promptly.
* Assess the effectiveness of the testing process, identify areas for improvement and implement changes to enhance the quality and efficiency of the testing activities.
* To adhere to all general security responsibilities as documented in the company security policy


**To join us as a Project Quality Specialist you will need the following experience and skills:**
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
* At least 1 years' experience with test management or similar
* Ability to work with data effectively to ensure quality testing
* Experience with project processes and procedures
* Experience with analysing and compiling data for reporting purposes
